titleTag: Can You Get a US Visa Appointment Within 3 Months?
h1: Can You Get a US Visa Appointment Within 3 Months? An Honest Answer, Post by Post
deck: At most consular posts in the world the answer is yes and it needs no effort at all. At about a dozen it is close to impossible without an emergency. The question is really about which of those two lists you are on.
metaDescription: Whether a US visa appointment within 3 months is realistic depends entirely on your post. The posts where it is routine, the ones where it is not, and what to do.

coverSpec.title: A US visa interview within three months is routine at most posts and out of reach at about a dozen
coverSpec.desc: In August 2026 a visitor visa interview inside 90 days was the default at Abuja, Lagos, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Porto Alegre, Perth, Kolkata, Nogales, Tijuana and Matamoros. It was not achievable at Toronto, Vancouver, Sydney, Hyderabad, Mumbai, New Delhi, Guadalajara or Bogota without a granted expedite request or, in Mexico and Canada, the $750 paid lane. The State Department publishes only B-1/B-2 averages where the next appointment is more than three months away, which makes three months a meaningful dividing line.

faq.q: Can I get a US visa appointment within 3 months?
faq.a: At most consular posts in the world, yes, and without doing anything special. In August 2026 that included Abuja, Lagos, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Porto Alegre, Perth, Kolkata, Nogales, Tijuana and Matamoros, all of which were booking inside 45 days. At about a dozen busy posts, including Toronto, Sydney, Hyderabad and Bogota, three months was not achievable through ordinary scheduling.

faq.q: Which posts cannot offer an interview inside three months?
faq.a: In August 2026 the visitor visa queues that ruled it out included Toronto at about 495 days, Sydney at about 435, Vancouver at about 435, Hyderabad at about 315, Bogota at about 270, Mumbai and New Delhi at about 255, Guadalajara at about 180 and Melbourne at about 165. Those figures move, so check the official wait time tool for your own post rather than relying on this list.

faq.q: Is there a reliable way to get inside three months at a slow post?
faq.a: Two, and both are narrow. A granted expedited appointment request, which is free but decided on documented urgency: medical emergency, funeral of an immediate family member, or a student within 60 days of a programme start. And the $750 paid expedite, which is available only at Mission Mexico and Mission Canada, only for B-1 and B-2 applicants, and only until 31 December 2026.

faq.q: Why does the State Department use three months as a threshold?
faq.a: Because it publishes average B-1/B-2 wait times only where the next available appointment is more than three months away. That makes three months an implicit dividing line in the official data: a post with no published average is, by definition, offering something inside that window. It is a useful shortcut when you are looking at the published table.

faq.q: Does a different post in my own country help?
faq.a: Frequently, and it is the most underused move available. In August 2026 an applicant in Sydney facing about 435 days could look at Perth at about 15, and an applicant in Hyderabad facing about 315 could look at Kolkata at about 60. Which posts your account offers is decided by the system rather than by preference, so check what is actually available to you before planning travel.

faq.q: Should I book a distant appointment or wait for a better one?
faq.a: Book. Always. An appointment you hold is the asset that everything else depends on: you cannot reschedule what you do not have, and you cannot request an expedite without an existing booking. Taking a date fourteen months out and improving on it is the standard path to an earlier interview, and refusing to book while you wait for something better is the most common self-inflicted delay in this process.

faq.q: Do student and work visas also take three months?
faq.a: Usually much less, even at the worst posts. In August 2026 student and petition-based categories were inside a month at every Australian post while Sydney's visitor queue ran past a year, and around 45 to 75 days at Mumbai and New Delhi against 255 for visitors. If you are in one of those categories, look up your own category rather than the headline visitor figure.

cta.heading: If your post is on the wrong list
cta.body: Three months at Toronto, Sydney or Hyderabad is not something ordinary scheduling delivers, and we would rather tell you that than sell you optimism. What can close the gap is persistence on the calendar plus the widest date range your plans allow, and that is the work we take on. Tell us your post, your current date and your deadline, and we will tell you honestly whether three months is realistic for you before you commit to anything.
